ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Allcargo Logistics Limited announced a significant leadership transition, with current MD & CEO Ketan Kulkarni resigning effective December 31, 2026, to assume a new Chief Growth Officer role within the Allcargo Group. Vijay Nehra, an accomplished leader with extensive transformation and operations experience, has been appointed as MD Designate from October 1, 2026, and will become MD & CEO from January 1, 2027 (subject to shareholder approval). This planned succession ensures leadership continuity and signals a potential strategic focus on transformation, with no material red flags evident beyond the accepted waiver of the outgoing CEO's full notice period.
